title: anthemis cretica subsp. argaea
intro: Anthemis cretica subsp. argaea, commonly known as a type of Anthemis plant, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis cretica subsp. argaea are attributed to its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
